subject: [hw] V20 -> D01: census - the AES/SHA2 "undecodable" rows do not exist in the vendor objects; V20 implemented/UNDEF list
body:
Two census facts from V20 (NEON two-register misc + structure load/store), both [V] on this host.

1. aese.8, sha1su1.32 and sha256su0.32 (FACTS.md 4.11, the unclassified mnemonics) are not real instructions in the five vendor objects. I scanned every 4-byte-aligned word of bin/vpud and lib/{libvpud_vcodec,libvcodecdrv,libvcodec_utility,libvcodec_oal}.so for the exact encoding families (masks from llvm-mc with -mattr=+crypto):
   AESE.8  (w & 0xFFB00FD0) == 0xF3B00300
   AESD.8  ... == 0xF3B00340    AESMC.8 ... == 0xF3B00380    AESIMC.8 ... == 0xF3B003C0
   SHA1H.32 (w & 0xFFBFFFC0) == 0xF3B902C0
   SHA1SU1.32 ... == 0xF3BA0380    SHA256SU0.32 ... == 0xF3BA03C0
   Result: 0 matches in all five objects (not even as data). The rows come from llvm-objdump decoding data bytes in .text (same class of artefact as the false sha1m.32 that V18 found in libvpud_vcodec: a BLX followed by an LDR). Suggested: drop those three rows or mark them as disassembly noise.
   (The three-register SHA forms sha1c/sha1p/sha1m/sha1su0/sha256h/sha256h2/sha256su1 are in the V18 encoding space and are also absent from the same scan: mask 0xF2BF0FD0 == 0xF2020C40 family, 0 hits.)

2. V20 classification. My class is exactly: (a) Advanced SIMD data-processing with bits 23-20 = 1D11, U=1 (two-register miscellaneous) plus U=0 (VEXT); (b) bits 23-19 = 10000 with bit4=1 and bit7=0 (one-register modified immediate). Consequences for the census table:
   - vmov.i32 (274) -> V20 modified immediate, implemented (also vmvn.i16/i32, vorr/vbic.i16/i32, vmov.i8/i16/i64, vmov.f32 for every cmode).
   - vtbl.8 (101), vtbx.8 (85) -> V20 two-reg misc (bits 11-10 = 10, len-1 in bits 9-8), implemented for 1-4 tables.
   - vdup.<size> from a lane -> V20 (bits 11-8 = 1100); vdup.<size> Dd, Rt (from a core register, 0xEE...) -> VFP/V17.
   - vmovn.i16/i32/i64, vqmovn.s/u*, vqmovun.* -> V20 (A = 2|size<<2, B = 2).
   - vshll.i8/i16/i32 (the maximum-shift form, e.g. F3B20301) -> V20 (A = 2|size<<2, B = 3, C = 0); the VSHLL with an explicit shift (F28.../F29.../F2A..., bit4=1) and vmovl -> V19.
   - vclt.s8/vclt.s32/vcle.f32 -> V20 (compare against zero).
   - vst1.32/vst1.64/vld1.64 -> V20 structure load/store.
   Full implemented/UNDEF table with encodings: gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v20/STATUS.md. Summary of what V20 returns UNDEF for: VCVT.F16.F32/VCVT.F32.F16 (half precision), the AES/SHA2 two-register forms above, and the encodings the ARM ARM leaves UNDEFINED (VREV32.32, VCNT/VMVN with size != .8, .F32 forms with size != 32, VUZP.32/VZIP.32 D, VTBL lists past d31, modified immediate cmode=1111/op=1, all-lanes stores, register lists wrapping d31, Rn=15).
   So the V20 acceptance check ("no mnemonic of my class used by the vendor libraries that I return UNDEF for") holds: vst1.32/vst1.64/vld1.64/vmov.i32/vtbl.8/vtbx.8 and the vclt/vcle forms are all implemented and unit-tested.

Test evidence: bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v20/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST V20 PASS 420350/420350 (includes a llvm-mc disassembler sweep of 9212 encoding words: 9192 must execute, 20 must UNDEF, all correct).
